hypothesis_under_test: The extracted executable representation is systematically more restrictive than the educator's actual decision process — extraction promotes optional/alternative/contextual cues into mandatory hard (spine-role) conditions.

method.data_source: DB strategies WHERE source='spec_onboarding' AND lifecycle_state='CANDIDATE', config.compiled_spec.spec.entry_conditions, deduped by video (ignoring x3 MCL/MES/MNQ symbol fan-out)
method.evidence_method: Used the extraction pipeline's own stored per-condition char-offset span to slice the exact evidence text out of the transcript, plus a +/-500/250 char context window, so every classification is anchored to the SAME evidence the extractor itself cited.
method.adversarial_bias: UNRESOLVED and ambiguous cases were NOT given benefit of the doubt toward JUSTIFIED_MANDATORY - the extractor must earn the mandatory label with explicit gate-language.
method.raters: 4 parallel first-pass rater agents (batch1-4, no cross-visibility) + 1 independent second-pass rater agent on a 4-concept/71-condition subsample (blind to first-pass labels) for inter-rater agreement.

robustness_check_using_second_pass_rater.description: Recomputed corpus aggregates substituting the independent SECOND-PASS rater's classifications (instead of first-pass) for the 4 subsample concepts (jlShztsY3oA, N7uP9V0Iktc, UBvfsImdI2U, ktkqq7QsN9Q), first-pass retained for the other 10 concepts.
